description.value: Tent-only camping stretched along a 2km pebble beach directly on Harrison Lake, with a handful of shaded forested sites; no potable water, no garbage service (pack everything out), and cash only — bring everything you need.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a rustic, tents-only recreation site on Harrison Lake operated by Recreation Sites and Trails BC. It explicitly states no potable water, no showers, no flush toilets, no electricity, no cellular service — consistent with OSM tags. Reservations are confirmed via a dedicated online reservations page. The fee structure is entirely vehicle-based (per vehicle overnight and visitor fees), with no mention of walk-in/bike-in rates, which is a concern for touring cyclists.
concerns: Fee structure is entirely vehicle-based — no walk-in or bike-in rate mentioned; unclear if cyclists without a vehicle would be accommodated
Cash only — no alternative payment accepted
No potable water available — cyclists must bring all water
No cellular service — no way to call for help in an emergency
Email listed as harrisoneast@hotmail.com on contact page but no phone number provided
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate campsite a touring cyclist could use, but the entire fee structure is vehicle-based (per vehicle overnight and visitor fees, cash only) with no mention of walk-in or bike-in rates. A cyclist arriving without a vehicle may face confusion or be turned away. No hiker/biker sites, no water, no services. Worth verifying whether cyclists without vehicles are accommodated.
enrichment_extras.notes: Managed by Greenshades Enterprises on behalf of Recreation Sites and Trails BC. Site opens May 15 for 2026 season.

wow_evidence: 2km pebble beach directly on Harrison Lake ... no potable water ... fee structure is entirely vehicle-based
